command:
set -eu
echo KERNEL_ACCESS_METADATA_BEGIN
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
cat /proc/self/status | awk '/^Uid:|^Gid:|^CapInh:|^CapPrm:|^CapEff:|^CapBnd:|^NoNewPrivs:|^Seccomp:/ {print}'
for p in /proc/sys/kernel/modules_disabled /proc/sys/kernel/kptr_restrict /sys/module/module/parameters/sig_enforce; do
if test -r "$p"; then echo "VALUE $p"; cat "$p"; fi
done
for p in /sys/module/qdf_tcon/sections/.text /sys/module/qdf_tcon/sections/.bss /dev/mem /dev/kmem /proc/kcore; do
if test -e "$p"; then stat -c '%F %a %n' "$p"; else echo "ABSENT $p"; fi
done
echo KERNEL_ACCESS_METADATA_END
